servinfo.title: Identification Plate
servinfo.ptxt: Identification plate (1) is installed at the center pillar lower side on the right body outer panel.
The identification plate has the following information:

item.ptxt: Model code (4) including the model information shownin Model Code Description below.

servinfosub.title: Model Code Description
servinfosub.ptxt: The composition of the model code and the descriptionof digits are as follows.

item.ptxt: The model code is composed of 9 characters.
The 8th and 9th characters indicate market code.

servinfosub.ptxt: The market code is used in this manual to facilitate exact identification of the vehicle specification.
